ios.desc:
Upgrade your photography – start your free 7-day trial today!

THE ORIGINAL: ProCamera is the ultimate photo and video app for enthusiasts, creatives, and professionals. Experience the power of a DSLR camera with ProCamera's innovative features and seamless integration with your iOS photo library.

ProCamera perfectly blends simplicity with sophistication: Choose from easy point-and-shoot mode, semi-automatic mode or dive into full manual controls with just a tap. Effortlessly capture stunning images and film like a pro with advanced features and support for external lenses and microphones.

The powerful editing suite allows you to elevate your images with a wide range of tools for complete creative control. Know everything about your captures with our pro-level EXIF/metadata viewer. Enjoy custom sharing options to easily remove geo-tags for increased privacy or downsize photos and videos to save data.

Trusted since 2009 and continuously refined through years of innovation, ProCamera is loved worldwide: Featured by Apple, numerous prestigious awards and more than 40k 5-star reviews! 

––– KEY FEATURES FOR UNRIVALED CONTROL –––
Independent focus & exposure control
Auto, Semi-Auto, full Manual mode
Manual focus & focus peaking
Exposure compensation with zebra stripes
Portrait mode with depth preview
RAW, ProRAW, TIFF, JPG & HEIF
Optical & digital zoom (up to 24x)
Manual white balance (incl. gray card calibration)
Support for all lenses (ultra wide, wide, tele, LiDAR)
48 MP photos (iPhone 14 Pro and up)
Configurable capture quality
Lock screen camera
Support for Camera Control Button (iPhone 16 and up)
Custom launch settings
Selftimer & ProTimer intervalometer
Selfie mode with display flash
Image stabilization on/off
EXIF & metadata viewer
Live Histogram
Aspect Ratios (4:3, 5:4, 3:2, 1:1, 16:9, 2:1, 2.4:1, 3:1, golden ratio)
Adjustable LED light
Rapid Fire photo series
Apple Watch Remote Trigger
Powerful gallery with iCloud integration
Support for iOS albums
Mirroring options
Anti-Shake
3D Tiltmeter
Photo Compass
Code Scanner (QR, Barcode,…)
Date stamp & copyright field
Volume button & full screen trigger
Lightbox (optional internal save location for easy file sharing)

––– ADDITIONAL VIDEO FEATURES –––
Video resolution options (4K, 1080, 720, 480 VGA)
Frame rates (24, 25, 30, 48, 50, 60, 96, 100, 120, 192, 200, 240 fps)
Codecs (H.264, H.265 HEVC, ProRes, ProRes RAW)
Log profile
High bitrate recording
Record to external USB-C drive
Connect bluetooth, lightni

quotes.text:
I created an account just to recommend shooting ProRaw with the Pro Camera app on an iPhone. There's even a setting to turn down some of the computational photography features (under 'Capture Quality'). Makes a world of difference!

https://www.procamera-app.com/en/

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/procamera/id694647259

I like to shoot with the ProCamera app on my iPhone, using the 'Natural' Capture Quality setting. It applies less post-processing than the default camera app while still giving you usable results.
